turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Why did my son find out from his phone?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
The vice principal knows already? Then tell me exactly what was said, and whether anything about Owen is written down anywhere.
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
Policy is policy. Then your own procedure, 4.2, says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody called me.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
A courtesy. Owen got a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and you call this a courtesy? On what evidence did you enter it?
